newsitem.title: USA: Belco withdraws Hugoton bid - AP.
newsitem.headline: Belco withdraws Hugoton bid - AP.

text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp withdrew its $296 million, $15 a share, bid for Hugoton Energy Corp, the Associated Press reported in the New York Times, citing Hugoton.
No officials from either company were available to comment.
Hugoton, based in Wichita, Kansas, said it would continue evaluating various strategic alternatives, including a sale or a merger, according to the paper.
New York-based Belco already owns 14.9 percent of Hugoton's shares.
Belco's shares closed unchanged at 21-1/2 Thursday, while Hugoton's shares closed down 3/16 at 14-1/16.
